items.title: John Pope Interview, 1959-05-01
items.q: Back in those days, we had Mr. Drago, Cummins, and they were all white bands, you know.

ctx.x: Did you have any competition with other bands or just?

Well, yes, we did. Back in those days, we had Mr. Drago, Cummins, and they were all white bands, you know. White band. Yes. Then we had a few colored bands, but they never did wake up to that point since then.
I imagine you had visits in Mobile from some of the other bands from New Orleans.
